titleEn: John Deere Introduces JD, the AI Assistant That Helps Farmers Put Their Data to Work
titleZh: 约翰迪尔推出AI助手JD，助力农民激活数据价值
summaryZh: 约翰迪尔在Operations Center平台中集成AI助手JD，农民可通过自然语言提问获取田间、机器和运营数据的分析结果，如燃油效率、播种质量、收获时机等。同时发布“农民数据承诺”，强调数据归属与控制权。JD将逐步扩展至草坪、建筑、道路和林业领域。
featuredReason: 约翰迪尔作为农业机械巨头，其AI助手与数据承诺战略展示了数据驱动农业的未来方向，对智慧畜牧领域的数字化平台建设具有借鉴意义。
contentFull:
By Deere & Co. 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 For more than a decade, John Deere Operations Center™ has helped farmers connect their field, machine, and operational data in a centralized platform. And now it’s being taken to the next level with JD, the artificial intelligence (AI) assistant built into Operations Center that gives farmers an entirely new way to put their data to work: by simply asking it a question. As AI makes farm data more useful and valuable, John Deere is also highlighting its Farmer Data Commitment, reinforcing that farmers’ data belongs to them, it remains under their control, and it should create value for their operation.

 A New Way to Put Farm Data to Work

 JD enables farmers to have a conversation with the vast amount of field, machine, and operational data they generate, creating the opportunity to improve yields, drive savings and strengthen farm profitability through AI. Instead of searching across multiple dashboards or reports, farmers can ask questions such as:

 How did my fuel use during tillage this year compare with the last three years? — helping identify best practices and result in fuel savings.

 How did singulation compare across my fields, and what impact did it have on yield? – enabling a better understanding of how equipment settings can impact yield.

 Which sprayer operator is covering the most acres per hour? – resulting in understanding operational efficiencies.

 When is the optimal time to harvest based on historical trends? — enabling better planning and management of labor.

 With JD, farmers can surface the right information quickly and receive practical responses grounded in their own data. The result is a simpler way to make sense of complex operational information and act with more confidence.

 “Farmers have more data available to them than ever before, but the value comes from their ability to use it in the moments that matter,” said Jahmy Hindman, Chief Technology Officer at John Deere. “JD changes the experience from navigating through a sea of data to simply asking it a question. It puts advanced data analysis within reach by enabling farmers to receive answers tailored to their farm and their needs in a matter of seconds.”

 Your Farm. Your Data. Your Call.

 As tools like JD make farm data more useful, John Deere believes that farmers should remain in control of their data, understand how it is used, and receive clear value from it. The Farmer Data Commitment outlines ten principles behind that approach:

 You control your farm data.

 John Deere does not sell your farm data.

 John Deere uses your farm data only as described in its agreements and policies and will communicate changes clearly before they take effect.

 John Deere will require dealers and connected partners to maintain transparent data practices.

 John Deere uses your farm data and aggregated, anonymized data to deliver measurable value to you through improved machine performance and decision-making insights.

 You can choose which third parties to share, and not share, your farm data with.

 You have the freedom to turn off the flow of your farm data to third parties at any time.

 John Deere does not use your farm data for agriculture commodity trading or speculation.

 You should receive clear value from your farm data.

 John Deere will continue to listen to farmers, strengthen its data practices, and develop new solutions that help you receive value from your farm data.

 “Farmers receive value from their data when they can use it to make better decisions, and we believe that value should come with control, transparency, and choice,” said Deanna Kovar, President, Worldwide Ag & Turf Division: Production and Precision Ag, Americas and Australia at John Deere. “Our view is simple: farmers should control their data, clearly understand how it is used, and benefit from the insights it can create. JD and the Farmer Data Commitment are part of the same vision for helping farmers put their data to work on their terms.”

 John Deere is opening a limited Early Access Program for select U.S. agricultural customers, allowing eligible participants to express interest in participation. The AI assistant will become more broadly available later this year through Operations Center on web, mobile, and eventually via in-cab display interface.

 As JD evolves, John Deere plans to introduce capabilities tailored to customers across turf, construction, roadbuilding, and forestry, extending its value across the company’s broader customer base.

 For more information on JD and the Farmer Data Commitment, visit Deere.com/YourData.

translationZh:
十多年来，约翰迪尔运营中心™帮助农民将田间、机器和运营数据连接到一个集中平台。现在，通过内置在运营中心中的AI助手JD，这一平台被提升到了新的水平，为农民提供了一种全新的方式利用数据：只需提问即可。随着AI使农业数据更加有用和有价值，约翰迪尔还强调了其“农民数据承诺”，重申农民的数据属于他们自己，数据仍在其控制之下，并应为其运营创造价值。

**利用农场数据的新方式**

JD使农民能够与他们产生的大量田间、机器和运营数据进行对话，通过AI创造提高产量、节省成本、增强农场盈利能力的机会。农民无需在多个仪表板或报告中搜索，只需提问，例如：

- 今年耕作期间的燃油使用量与过去三年相比如何？——帮助识别最佳实践并节省燃油。

- 各田块的播种均匀度如何，对产量有何影响？——更好地理解设备设置如何影响产量。

- 哪位喷雾机操作员每小时覆盖面积最大？——了解运营效率。

- 根据历史趋势，何时是收获的最佳时机？——更好地规划和管理劳动力。

借助JD，农民可以快速获取正确的信息，并收到基于自身数据的实用回答。结果是，以更简单的方式理解复杂的运营信息，并更有信心地采取行动。

“农民拥有的数据比以往任何时候都多，但价值在于他们在关键时刻使用数据的能力，”约翰迪尔首席技术官Jahmy Hindman表示。“JD将体验从在数据海洋中导航转变为直接提问。它使先进的数据分析触手可及，让农民在几秒钟内获得针对其农场和需求的定制答案。”

**你的农场。你的数据。你做主。**

随着JD等工具使农业数据更有用，约翰迪尔认为农民应保持对其数据的控制，了解数据的使用方式，并从中获得明确的价值。“农民数据承诺”概述了实现这一方法的十项原则：

- 你控制你的农场数据。

- 约翰迪尔不出售你的农场数据。

- 约翰迪尔仅按照协议和政策使用你的农场数据，并会在变更生效前明确通知。

- 约翰迪尔将要求经销商和关联合作伙伴保持透明的数据实践。

- 约翰迪尔使用你的农场数据和聚合的匿名数据，通过改进机器性能和决策洞察为你带来可衡量的价值。

- 你可以选择与哪些第三方共享或不共享你的农场数据。

- 你可以随时停止向第三方传输你的农场数据。

- 约翰迪尔不会将你的农场数据用于农业商品交易或投机。

- 你应从你的农场数据中获得明确的价值。

- 约翰迪尔将继续倾听农民的意见，加强数据实践，并开发新解决方案，帮助你从农场数据中获得价值。

“农民在能够利用数据做出更好决策时获得价值，我们认为这种价值应伴随着控制、透明和选择，”约翰迪尔全球农业与草坪事业部生产与精密农业总裁Deanna Kovar表示。“我们的观点很简单：农民应控制他们的数据，清楚了解数据的使用方式，并受益于数据产生的洞察。JD和‘农民数据承诺’是同一愿景的一部分，帮助农民按照自己的方式利用数据。”

约翰迪尔正在为选定的美国农业客户开放有限的早期访问计划，符合条件的参与者可以表达参与兴趣。AI助手将于今年晚些时候通过运营中心在网页、移动端以及最终在驾驶室显示界面更广泛地提供。

随着JD的发展，约翰迪尔计划为草坪、建筑、道路建设和林业客户推出定制功能，将价值扩展到公司更广泛的客户群。

有关JD和“农民数据承诺”的更多信息，请访问Deere.com/YourData。
